Consonantal i

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

player noun

also fellow player

classical

lūsor, lūsōris m.

noun, third declension

Seneca’s line on the good player (Ben. II 17, 4) is quoted in Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae.

Examples

  • necesse est autem lūsor bonus aliter illam conlūsōrī longō, aliter brevī mittat

    a good player must throw the ball one way to a tall partner and another way to a short oneSen. Ben. II 17, 4

  • Baba lūsor bonus est.

    Baba is a good player.Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

Other words

  • collūsor, collūsōris m. — fellow player

    noun, third declension · also used · classical

See also ball, team, play.
